_notes: 规则从 paytable/Paytable-M15.md 翻译而来（2026-04-23 onboarding）。
核心区别 vs M1:
- Wild 只有一种（不是 M1 的 Diamond1=wild2x + Diamond2=wild3x），multiplier=2 per wild
- Wild product: 0/1/2 wild → 1/2/4；3 wild 触发 pure_wild 200× 而不是 8× 加成
- Bonus 只在 reel 3 出现（reel 1/2 无 Bonus），触发 Feature Play（Phase 2 实现）
- Jackpot 是独立 symbol，3-Jackpot = 1000× 但'不可随机转出'，在 reel 上完全不出现 → 纯 declared pay
- 无 mixed-Seven 组合（M1 有 pay_id 10 = Seven1+Seven2 共同组），M15 只有单 high7 一个 7 symbol
Feature Play（Phase 2 延后）:
- Bonus 在 reel 3 payline 出现时触发
- 每轮 1-5 个 x（加权抽样）+ 0-2 个 y（加权）
- 最多 3 次 reroll + 1 次强制接受 = 4 轮
- 测试策略：多于 40× 直接接受
- Feature RTP 单独统计，不并入主游戏 RTP
当前 spec 把 Bonus 标 filler（payline 短路到无 pay），留待 Phase 2 接 feature engine
Jackpot 处理:
- Jackpot symbol 分类为 wild 以便 pure_wild 规则匹配 {Jackpot: 3}
- multiplier=1 占位（never on reels 所以实际不生效）
- reel_strips.json 里 Jackpot 完全不出现 → P(3 Jackpot) = 0，永不触发 engine pure_wild 路径
- pay_id 1 标 rtp_excluded=true + grand_jackpot=true → 即使 somehow 命中也返回 None
- 存在于 spec 仅为 UI declared-pays 端点展示（/api/virtual/paytable/M15sim）

features.name: FeaturePlay
features._status: EV analysis shipped (slot_designer.engine.feature_m15 with per-card weighted sampling, v5 2026-04-23); spin-time engine integration deferred to Phase 2
features._design: 10 x-cards with values (1000,100,50,50,20,20,10,10,5,5) + 2 y-cards (both ×2); each round: (1) roll count_x in [1,5] by x_count_weights, (2) roll count_y in [0,2] by y_count_weights, (3) weighted-draw count_x x-cards WITHOUT replacement by x_value_weights, (4) weighted-draw count_y y-cards by y_value_weights, (5) R = sum(x_drawn) × product(y_drawn). Test strategy: auto-accept when R ≥ 40; else reroll. 3 reroll + 1 forced accept = 4 rounds max.
features._default_weights_note: The four weight tuples below are the v5 design for MODE 1 specifically. Other modes override via per-mode `feature_params` in their weights.json (see slot_designer/weights/M15/mode_<N>/weights.json). See also slot_designer/weights/M15/MODE_DESIGN.md for the 4-mode design table.
_weights_rationale: Design target per user brief (cross-machine mode RTP rule):
Feature volatility: mid-high CV (conditional CV 0.74 mode 1; session CV high from rarity)
x_count_weights = (5, 40, 40, 12, 3) — 2-3 offer dominant per user UX brief
y_count_weights = (75, 20, 5)       — narrow y to lower EV floor for mode 1
x_value_weights picked via binary-search alpha=-2.45 on v^alpha to hit EV=46
Structural discovery: count_x=(5,40,40,12,3) + count_y=(60,30,10) has EV
floor ~45.5 because count_x ≥ 3 cannot draw all-5 (only 2 physical 5-cards
in pool). So mode 1 uses narrower count_y=(75,20,5) to lower floor to ~35,
giving alpha breathing room to target 46 with moderate skew.
mode 2: count_y=(60,30,10), x_value_weights for EV=60,  trigger 2.75% (1/36)
mode 5: count_y=(40,35,25), x_value_weights for EV=132, trigger 2.77% (1/36)
mode 7: same as mode 1 (feature unchanged; base cuts small wins for Total=85%)
